text_block_list.text:
I visited a shrine together with Taiki 
Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Shrine, arrived! Ohh, it's such a quiet 
and peaceful place, yes~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Hunnyaka hunnyaka~!! —Honnyaka 
honnyaka~!!
choice_data_list: (That voice is neither quiet nor calm!?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyamu-nyamu-nyamu~~!! 
Hunnyaka-honnyaka-great-fortune-great-fortune...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Fukukitaruuu! Whatcha doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taiki-san! I was just offering a 
prayer to be blessed with Great Fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lady Shiraoki gave me a divine revelation 
to "go pull an 'Excellent Luck' fortune at 
the shrine."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, why don't you draw one 
with me, Taiki-san?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"An omikuji! Dat's fortune-telling, like 
what Fukukitaru is always talking about, 
yes?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The fortune-telling Fukukitaru teaches me 
is always SO fun! I love it, DESU!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want to get lots and lots of happiness 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, with a happy Umamusume like 
Taiki-san around, I'm guaranteed maximum 
good fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, let us go! Fortune awaits!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hoeeeeeekh!! Please grant this humble one 
great fortune~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great fortune, please please! Here goes 
nooothiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I really got Great Fortune, 
YES~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay!! Omikuji is so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-Why did Taiki-san get Great Blessing... 
and I got Great Curse...?! What is the 
meaning of this...?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Non! Fukukitaru, never give up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we draw a lot of fortunes, we're bound 
to get Great Blessing, YES!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san, doing that with a fortune slip 
is strictly forbidden... N-No, wait!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lady Shiraoki never said "pull Great 
Fortune on your first try"—th-that 
means...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! One more challenge, Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa~~~~! One more challenge~~~~!

—And so, in the end, both of them managed 
to draw "Great Blessing" fortunes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Now both of us are happy, yes! Good 
things are surely coming our way♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer. I drew Great Misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san! That means there's nowhere to 
go from here but up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's a graaaand divine oracle from a 
fortune slip saying that even if I'm in a 
period of terrible luck right now, things 
are about to turn around!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru... So many difficult Japanese 
words, I do not underSTAND.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Terrible Luck is very happy!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Great Curse is very happy! Yaaay! I 
did it~!

Taiki Shuttle is happy, but... there's no 
changing the fact that it was 'Terrible 
Luck.'
